profile.headline: Front-end Engineer
profile.summary: Over 10 years of enterprise software development. Adaptable to new technologies and able to fluidly move between projects and teams. Proficient with Agile software development principles and practices. Comfortable speaking to groups and leading demos for business partners. Skilled at both frontend and backend development.
